output.question: Has Ford announced layoffs?

passages.quote: Bei den Ford-Werken in Köln müssen noch 500 Mitarbeiter aus dem Abbauprogramm das Unternehmen mit einer Abfindung verlassen.
Ford Motor Co. said Tuesday it would cut up to 1,000 jobs at its electric auto plant in Cologne, Germany
The company is planning to further reduce its European workforce by 4,000 positions by the end of 2027, pending consultations with its European social partners.

output.answer: Yes—Ford Motor Company has announced job cuts. The most recent specific update found, reported by WDR on September 22, 2026, said 500 employees still had to leave Ford’s Cologne operations with severance under an existing reduction program; these were not additional cuts. On September 16, 2025, Ford announced up to 1,000 job cuts at its Cologne electric-vehicle plant, using voluntary departures and buyouts where possible. Earlier, Ford’s November 20, 2024 release announced plans to reduce its European workforce by 4,000 positions by the end of 2027, pending consultations.
caveats: These figures describe announced reductions or reported remaining departures, not verified totals of completed layoffs; they should not be added together.
No newer company-wide layoff announcement was verified in the sources reviewed as of November 11, 2026; this does not establish that none exists.

key_facts.fact: WDR reported that 500 employees still had to leave Ford’s Cologne operations with severance under an existing program, explicitly stating that these were not additional cuts.
Ford announced up to 1,000 job cuts at its Cologne electric-vehicle plant, to be achieved through voluntary departures and buyouts as far as possible.
Ford announced plans to reduce its European workforce by 4,000 positions by the end of 2027, pending consultations with its European social partners.
